name: strictyaml
note: Wraps ruamel.yaml; returns strings unless a schema types them.
reason: Excluded: strictyaml 1.7.3 strictyaml.load(str) rejects both valid controls before returning a tree (FlowMappingDisallowed at catalog.yaml line 11 `tags: [alpha, ...]` and order.yaml line 11 `flags: []`); strictyaml deliberately disallows flow style and anchors/aliases, and without a schema returns scalars as strings, so it cannot match the typed trees. Probe: python:3.13-slim, PyYAML 6.0.3 / ruamel.yaml 0.19.1 / strictyaml 1.7.3 from PyPI, 2026-11-17.

name: pyyaml-ft
family: PyYAML fork for free-threaded Python (module yaml_ft)
note: Fork of PyYAML published for free-threading support.
reason: Excluded as a byte-identical fork of the selected PyYAML parser (fgergo/mp3 precedent): in the PyYAML-ft 8.0.0 sdist, lib/yaml_ft/scanner.py, parser.py, composer.py, reader.py and 8 more of its 18 non-test modules are byte-identical to PyYAML 6.0.3 lib/yaml, and 2,208 of 2,398 distinct non-test lines longer than 25 characters also occur in PyYAML (the rest is free-threading registry code). Its safe_load gives the same trees on both controls (probe, Python 3.13).

name: pydantic-yaml
note: Loads with ruamel.yaml YAML(typ="safe", pure=True) and validates into a pydantic model.
reason: Excluded as a mapping layer (laravie precedent): pydantic_yaml 1.7.0 parse_yaml_raw_as(model_type, raw) calls ruamel.yaml YAML(typ="safe", pure=True).load and then validates the parsed tree into the given pydantic model; its own code maps an already-parsed tree into models and its documented API requires a model type.

name: pyyaml-include
reason: Excluded: pyyaml-include 2.2 provides a Constructor for an !inc tag that a PyYAML Loader calls; it has no YAML parse API of its own and the controls contain no tags.

name: oyaml
note: Ordered-dict shim over PyYAML; shared family.
reason: Excluded as an empty compatibility shim on supported Pythons: oyaml 1.0 (single 53-line oyaml.py) registers its OrderedDict map constructor only when dicts are not order-preserving (sys.version_info < 3.7) and otherwise ends with `from yaml import *`; on Python 3.13, `oyaml.safe_load is yaml.safe_load` and `oyaml.load is yaml.load` are both True, so no oyaml code runs during a load. It gives the PyYAML trees on both controls because it is PyYAML.

name: ruyaml
reason: Excluded as a renamed predecessor of the selected ruamel.yaml parser (zend-json / trust-dns-proto precedent): ruyaml 0.91.0 forks ruamel.yaml 0.17.17 (its CHANGES stop there) under a new module name and has had no release since 2021; 1,485 of 2,081 distinct lines longer than 25 characters in its scanner/parser/composer/reader/constructor/resolver also occur in ruamel.yaml 0.19.1, the rest being four years of upstream changes.

name: yamlordereddictloader
note: PyYAML Loader/SafeLoader subclasses that build OrderedDict mappings.
reason: Excluded as a mapping layer over PyYAML (oyaml/laravie precedent): yamlordereddictloader 0.4.2 (one 88-line module) subclasses yaml.Loader/SafeLoader and only replaces construct_mapping/construct_yaml_map to build OrderedDict instead of dict from PyYAML's composed nodes; it changes no scanning, parsing or resolution, and Python dicts already keep insertion order.

name: yamlloader
note: OrderedDict loader/dumper mixins for PyYAML (pure and C loaders).
reason: Excluded as a mapping layer over PyYAML (oyaml/laravie precedent): yamlloader 1.6.0 ordereddict/loaders.py adds an OrderedLoaderMixin whose only code is construct_yaml_map/construct_mapping building OrderedDict from PyYAML's composed nodes, mixed into each PyYAML loader class; no scanning, parsing or resolution of its own.
